categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Fixes a race condition in the HTTP server where pipelined requests with 'Connection: close' can have their responses dropped due to premature client disconnection. The worker thread clears m_keep_alive before locking m_send_mutex, causing the I/O thread to observe an empty buffer with keep-alive disabled and close the connection before the subsequent response is enqueued.
